### Master Directory Structure

```text
/
├── package.json                 # Vite + Project dependencies
├── vite.config.js             # Vite configuration
├── AGENTS.md                   # Workspace instructions
├── README.md                   # Project overview
├── shared/                     # Reusable AAA Core Systems
│   ├── audio/                  # Web Audio API Synthes/SFX Engine
│   ├── camera/                 # CameraShake & Motion systems
│   ├── collision/              # Hand-written primitive math (AABB, Circle)
│   ├── core/                   # GameLoop, InputManager (Keyboard/Gamepad), TimeScale
│   ├── entities/                # ObjectPool, EntityManager, EntityBase
│   ├── graphics/                # PostProcessing (Bloom, Trails), ParticleManager
│   ├── math/                   # Procedural Noise, Vector/Matrix utilities
│   └── ui/                     # Glassmorphism HUD & Score systems
└── [GameName]/                # Isolated Game Implementation
    ├── index.html              # Entry point & UI Overlay
    ├── main.js                 # Scene initialization & Bootstrap
    ├── Engine.js               # Core game state machine (Win/Loss/Loop)
    ├── Renderer.js              # Three.js Scene, Lights, & Post-processing setup
    ├── World.js                # Procedural geometry & Environment generation
    └── Entities.js             # Game-specific object logic & Spawning
```
